posts.text:
Although I supported Musk in his suit against OpenAI, and admire what he did for electric cars, I am afraid my considered overall view is not very different from this:


Seth Abramson (@SethAbramson)

Candidly I have no idea why anyone does any business with him at all. He's made a lot of money for himself—on the back of taxpayer subsidies—and I'm sure he's made a very small number of people very wealthy. But he's a *significant* net negative for the other 99.9%+ of the world.
